mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tool_invocation_log ( tenant_id, agent_id, session_id, user_id, kind, tool_name, mcp_id, cli_id, outcome, error_message, args_json, result_excerpt, duration_ms, start_time, end_time, ts ) VALUES
(#{row.tenantId}, #{row.agentId}, #{row.sessionId}, #{row.userId}, #{row.kind}, #{row.toolName}, #{row.mcpId}, #{row.cliId}, #{row.outcome}, #{row.errorMessage}, #{row.argsJson}, #{row.resultExcerpt}, #{row.durationMs}, #{row.startTime}, #{row.endTime}, #{row.ts})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(l.ts, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date FROM tool_invocation_log l WHERE l.tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE(l.ts) >= #{floor} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tool_invocation_stats s WHERE s.stat_date = DATE(l.ts) AND s.tenant_id = l.tenant_id ) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(l.ts, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY stat_date ASC
